verdict.rationale: There's suggestive evidence that Cerebras adds new open-weight models fairly quickly (e.g., Qwen 3.8 27B appears in official docs and is called out by a community user as one of the strongest models they've hosted, even ahead of availability on OpenRouter), and the model catalog docs (choose-a-model, overview) frame the platform as tracking new open-source alternatives. However, there's no explicit vendor commitment or documented release-speed metric, and one community comment notes patchy/delayed integration with third-party tools 'even through openrouter' for earlier models. Missing for 10: an explicit stated SLA or track record showing time-to-availability after model release, and broader corroboration beyond one or two model examples.
